outline:
瞭解企業經營的內涵、系統、理念、策略、管理活動、實務及企業經營診斷模式。其中包含企業內外在環境分析、經營者之任務與特性及企業內部診斷等範圍。
The purpose of Business Management & Diagnosis course has included the introductory of a new management paradigm, systems, concepts, strategies, management activities, practices and diagnosis. The discussion of external and internal environment, business mission, business process reengineering, process flow management and SMEs (small & medium enterprises) diagnosis model will be covered to effectively implement the business evaluation.

flexible_learning.content: 本課程將系統性量化價值投資分析建立財務模型，搭配全球化的上市企業資料，客觀的分析企業的內在價值，進而深入討論其商業模式與企業策略。

參考書目
1.Alice Schroeder(2018)雪球：巴菲特傳（最新增訂版）(The Snowball: Warren Buffett and the Business of Life)
2.Warren Buffett; Lawrence A. Cunningham/ Ed.(2017)巴菲特寫給股東的信〔全新增修版〕(The Essays of Warren Buffett: Lessons for Corporate America, Fourth Edition)
3.Charles T. Munger(2019)窮查理的普通常識（增修版）：巴菲特50年智慧合夥人查理．蒙格的人生哲學(Poor Charlie’s Almanack: The Wit and Wisdom of Charles T. Munger)
4.Howard Marks(2017)投資最重要的事：一本股神巴菲特讀了兩遍的書(The Most Important Thing Illuminated: Uncommon Sense for the Thoughtful Investor)
5.Pat Dorsey(2016)護城河投資優勢：巴菲特獲利的唯一法則(The Little Book that Builds Wealth: The Knockout Formula for Finding Great Investments)
